sec.title: August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 292)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio, BBC Radio 4, and syndication, Bob Trout & William L. Shirer reporting on the Axis partitioning of Romania, Bud Abbott & Lou Costello's Western movie burlesque for Ipana Toothpaste, poetry and chamber music on *Music and the Muse*, Scotland Yard's Roger West on BBC Radio 4, Hallmark's *Radio Reader's Digest*, and Lum & Abner buying a trailer office for Horlick's Malted Milk (1935–1971):
